name: Tip Coin Button
description: Tip button that, on click, tilts and tosses a shaded 3D coin in an arc, then lands it and reveals a thank you message before resetting.
contents: Animated coin with front, back and edge faces and a shine
Thank you message shown after the coin lands
behavior: Click shakes the button and the label fades while the button shrinks into a slot
Coin flips with a random spin count and rotation along a parabolic arc
Thank you text pops in after landing, then the button resets after about 1.5s
editableByProps: Coin size, button size and flip duration

needsCodeEdit.where: tb-coin__front and tb-coin__back rules in the CSS constant

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the arc height of the toss

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Font is not loaded by the component, the host page must load Quicksand or pass another fontFamily
